sample_unit: benchmark conversations (five i.i.d. trials per agent)

links.outcome: Consistency of agent success across five repeated trials (Pass^5 vs Pass@5)
links.effect: Best agents reach Pass@5 over 90% on IncreQA and 60-70% on AdaptQA, but Pass^5 is substantially lower, with gaps of up to about 60%.
links.quote: Experiments with state-of-the-art LLMs (e.g., o4-mini and Gemini-2.5-Flash) over five i.i.d. trials show that while the best-performing agents achieve Pass@5 of over 90% (at least one of five trials) on IncreQA and 60-70% on AdaptQA, their Pass^5 (consistent success across all five trials) is substantially lower, with gaps of up to about 60%.

unlisted_practices: Benchmarking EHR database agents on clarifying ambiguous user queries and resolving value mismatches with tools before generating SQL

screen.reason: The study develops and tests an automated benchmark (EHR-ChatQA) to evaluate interactive LLM database agents accessing EHRs via SQL generation and user clarification.
